A Yorkshire Terrier, often called a Yorkie, is a small dog breed that comes from England. Yorkies are famous for their long, silky hair and their confident personalities. Even though they are tiny, they are brave, energetic, and full of curiosity. Yorkshire Terriers are very loyal to their owners and love spending time with their families. They are intelligent dogs that can learn tricks and commands quickly. Yorkies enjoy playing, going for walks, and exploring new places. Because of their small size, they are a good choice for people who live in apartments, but they still need daily exercise and attention. #yorkie #moodboard #dog #aesthetic #fyp
